title: 1. Read criteria and plan test coverage
notes: Read acceptance-criteria.json and .rhino-plan.md to list all criteria and extras.

title: 2. Audit existing tests and factories
notes: Examine existing tests under test/ and test factories/fixtures.

title: 3. Write comprehensive Minitest test suite
notes: Write Minitest feature/integration tests covering all acceptance criteria and extras.

title: 4. Run test suite and fix failures
notes: Execute bundle exec rails test and fix any test failures.

title: 5. Update acceptance-criteria.json and verify coverage
notes: Mark acceptance criteria as tested in acceptance-criteria.json and verify full coverage.
